headline: Caterpillar Acquires Fabick Cat Dealership
summary: Caterpillar Inc. acquired John Fabick Tractor Company, a long-standing Cat dealer serving portions of Missouri, Illinois, and Michigan.
why: Caterpillar Inc. is a leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment. Dealership acquisitions integrate distribution channels directly into the manufacturer's network.

impacts.name: Caterpillar Inc.
impacts.why: Acquiring a major regional dealer alters Caterpillar's direct distribution footprint.
